results.title: Christmas Scavenger Hunt Printable, 12 Indoor Clues, Picture Hunt & Editable Final Clue
results.description:
Make a little Christmas magic at home with a ready-to-print indoor scavenger hunt. Follow 12 rhyming clues to a festive surprise, or play the matching picture hunt with younger children. Change the final clue to send players to your own prize hiding place.

YOU WILL RECEIVE
• 9-page Christmas hunt in A4 PDF
• The same 9-page pack in US Letter PDF
• Editable final-clue replacement in A4 and US Letter PDFs
• START_HERE printing and editing guide

INSIDE THE 9-PAGE PACK
• Grown-up instructions and a secret hiding plan with answers
• 12 numbered indoor clue cards, including the ready-to-use final clue
• 8-picture hunt mat and 8 matching cards to cut out and hide
• Christmas Clue Champion certificate
• 4 blank bonus clue cards to write your own clues

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
The rhyming trail is suggested for ages 5-9, with an adult reading aloud when needed. It uses common indoor spots: shoes, sofa, fridge door, mirror, books, table, towel, bed, socks, coat, toys and the Christmas tree.
The picture hunt is a separate matching game suggested for ages 2-5 with adult supervision. Hide the included picture cards so children can find and tick the matches. No reading or Christmas decorations are required for the picture game.

EDITABLE FINAL CLUE
Only the text on the replacement card 12 is digitally editable. Download the matching EDIT_FINAL PDF and open it in desktop Adobe Acrobat Reader. Enter up to four short lines, save a copy, check it, print and swap it for card 12. The other 11 clues, layout, fonts, artwork and picture game are fixed. Phone and browser PDF apps may not save or print form fields reliably. No Canva account is needed.

PRINT & PLAY
Choose A4 (210 x 297 mm) or US Letter (8.5 x 11 in). Print single-sided at 100% / Actual Size, then cut out the cards. Colour printing is recommended. You supply the printer, paper, scissors, pencil, optional tape and optional reward. Colours vary by screen and printer.

PLEASE NOTE
Digital download only; no physical item or props will be posted. Listing scenes are digitally staged product mockups. Artwork, copy and mockup photography were created with AI assistance and checked by MetaGrid. Adult supervision and adult cutting are required. Hide cards only in reachable, dry, safe places, never inside appliances or anywhere requiring climbing.

PERSONAL USE
Print for your own household, classroom or private party. Do not resell, redistribute or share the digital files, or use the designs in products for sale.

After purchase, download your files from Etsy's Purchases section using a web browser. The four PDFs are supplied directly, with a separate START_HERE guide.

results.title: Christmas Scavenger Hunt Printable for Kids, 12 Indoor Clue Cards and Host Setup Map, Christmas Eve PDF
results.description:
Follow a 12-clue indoor trail to a Christmas surprise. The Missing Christmas Spark is a simple printable treasure hunt with fixed household clues and a host-only hiding map.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
Four PDFs: US Letter color, US Letter low-ink, A4 color, and A4 low-ink. Each PDF contains 4 pages: quick-start instructions, a host-only setup map, and two pages containing the 12 numbered clue cards. The same 12 clues appear in all four versions.

SETUP
The host gives clue 1 to the players. Each clue leads to the location of the NEXT clue. Clue 12 leads to a host-provided surprise beneath the Christmas tree. A handwritten note can be the surprise; no purchased prize is necessary.

REQUIRED LOCATIONS
A pair of shoes, a sofa with a loose cushion, a bookshelf, a dining table, a clean towel, a pillow, a coat pocket, a mirror, an empty laundry basket, a board game box, a blanket, and a Christmas tree. Check these before buying: the clues are fixed and cannot be edited.

DETAILS
English only. Designed for readers around ages 6-9 with adult help as needed. This age range is an editorial estimate, not a child-tested suitability claim. Adult setup and supervision required. Use only safe, reachable hiding places. No climbing or appliances. This is a clue trail, not a lock-based escape room. No fixed duration is promised.

PRINTING & DELIVERY
Digital download only. No physical product, paper, scissors, or prize is included. Once Etsy confirms payment, download the files from your Etsy purchases using a web browser. Choose the PDF matching your paper size and print only the pages you want. Colors can vary between screens and printers.

USE
For your own household and private gatherings only. Do not redistribute the files, sell copies, or use them as resale templates. Contact the shop through Etsy messages if there is a file problem.

CREATIVE PROCESS
Created with generative AI assistance; text and layout checked during preparation.

results.description:
Friendsgiving Games Bundle Printable, Instant Download

Keep the whole table laughing with this Friendsgiving games printable bundle. It's 12 Thanksgiving party games for adults and teens, including trivia, thankful bingo, most likely to, would you rather, who said it and a gratitude emoji guess, all with original questions.

A family trivia set, answer keys and score sheets are included, so it works for a Friendsgiving with friends, a big family Thanksgiving or a game night at the office.

WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE
- Thanksgiving trivia: 60 original questions (30 family, 30 adult) plus answer key
- Thankful bingo: 30 unique cards plus calling sheet
- Who's most likely to: 30 prompts
- Would you rather: 50 cards
- Who said it: fill-in cards (24) plus blanks
- Gratitude emoji guess: 25 original puzzles plus key
- Leftovers scramble: 30 words plus key

- Files: PDF US Letter + PDF A4 (54 pages each), plus a separate ink-saver B&W PDF

PERFECT FOR
- Friendsgiving parties
- Thanksgiving dinner with family
- Office and team Thanksgiving lunches
- College and dorm parties
- Youth groups and church fellowship
- Family game night

HOW TO USE
1. Download the Letter or A4 PDF.
2. Pick the games you want and print them (ink-saver works fine).
3. Cut the card games apart.
4. Hand out pens, set a timer and play.
5. Keep score on the score sheet and crown a winner.

PRINTING TIPS
- Print game sheets on regular 20-24 lb paper and card sets on 65 lb cardstock so they hold up to handling.
- Set scaling to 'Actual size' / 100%.
- Use the ink-saver black-and-white version for big groups.
- Laminate or slip cards into sheet protectors to reuse them with dry-erase markers.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
12 games for three dollars, enough for the whole evening, with original content and answer keys so the host doesn't have to prep.

DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
